public_rationale: The affidavit does not establish three dollars of compute spending per dollar of revenue. It gives expenditure above $10 billion and revenue above $5 billion. Dividing the thresholds gives two, but treating either threshold as an exact amount would be wrong. Because both actual amounts are unspecified, the affidavit also does not disprove a ratio of three. The claimed ratio remains unproven.
limitations: The declaration is a sworn financial description, not a complete statement of accounts.
A failure of the cited evidence to establish the ratio is not proof that the actual ratio was different.
The located declaration is dated March 9, not March 6.
